summary: Keep the staged REST compatibility API loopback-only and synchronize its published endpoint and status schema with the implementation.
reason: Independent review found that the earlier OpenAPI bearer declaration, endpoint, and response schema disagreed with the loopback-only compatibility service; a non-loopback address could expose collection and MFA routes without an intentional cutover decision.
validated_outcome: Loopback-address and REST status-contract regressions pass before full Go, dogfood, and publication validation gates.
